title: On a new modular equation of degree five and Eisenstein series identities of associated levels
summary: In this research article, we obtain few theta function identities of level ten employing Ramanujan's $_1 ψ_1$ summation formula. Using these identities, we derive a new modular equation of degree five. Further, we establish Eisenstein series identities of level ten using Bailey's very-well poised $_6 ψ_6$ summation formula.
